restrictions: Samples n = 256*NB (NB = 1321860456990702717723188087783627883, n about 0.99446*2^128) iid uniform 55-byte complete messages: 21 fixed zero bytes followed by 34 bytes from independent uniform random words; each is one padded block hashed from the standard IV with 37 rounds and feed-forward.

Searches for repeats of a 256-bit key that is an explicit bijective re-encoding of the full final state (inverse maps given in proof.md Section 4), so key collisions are exactly full-digest collisions; no truncation.
Success >= 0.3901 is distribution-free (valid for every fixed 256-bit-output function); no random-oracle, balance, independence or differential premise.

Classical 256-bit word RAM, 64 registers, base-plus-immediate addressing, every load/store/branch/random word charged at 1/2644; worst-case total work and memory bounds; no collision witness or full execution is claimed.
